concerns.text: Task T006 [P] modifies `code/agent.py` while Task T008 [P] also modifies the same file (extends it). Marking both as parallel‑safe `[P]` is incorrect because concurrent execution would cause write‑conflict on `code/agent.py`. One of the tasks must drop the `[P]` tag or be sequenced explicitly.

Task T009 [P] creates `code/analysis.py` and Task T010 [P] subsequently adds to the same file. Both are labeled `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but they cannot safely run in parallel due to shared file writes. The `[P]` tag should be removed from at least one of these tasks.
